sourceVersion: Version 0.5.64 - Backstory Legacy Purchase Content Draft
notes: This file is a draft-only planning catalog and is not imported by the Legacy runtime, account meta UI, Backstory Eligibility resolver, or character creator.

Backstory records describe formative past conditions that shaped the new character; they are not current job titles, current social identities, owned status, present employment, or present obligations.

Records in this file are future eligibility support concepts only. They grant no starter skills, attributes, abilities, items, coin, contacts, market effects, family history, social status, magic access, mounts, medical effects, oath behavior, estate ownership, or institution membership.

Record names and playerFacingSummary fields should remain suitable for future player-facing display by describing past shaping experience only. implementationSummary and guardrails are internal Codex/design guidance and are not player-facing copy.

A later implementation pass must migrate approved records into runtime-owned Legacy content with explicit visibility, purchase, scope, storage, resolver, and UI tests before any record can become live.

records.name: Market-Learned Habits
records.playerFacingSummary: Crowded market lanes, stall work, bargaining, and errand running shaped your practical sense of value and attention.
records.implementationSummary: Draft-only internal candidate preserving possible future access to a formative market-labor background.
guardrails: Represents formative past experience only; does not make the new character currently employed, socially recognized, contracted, or obligated as a vendor.
Does not grant discounts, contacts, passive income, business ownership, extra coin, or inventory.
Does not replace any required source-run or earned trade evidence if a later resolver rule requires it.
Does not stack with any parent or child backstory package.
